# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Workspace Overview

This is a home directory workspace containing multiple projects. It is **not** a single repository. Each major project has its own `CLAUDE.md` — always read the project-specific CLAUDE.md before working in that project.

The global cognitive substrate instructions live at `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and are always loaded automatically. This file covers **cross-project navigation and shared patterns**.

## Project Map

### Active Projects (with test commands)

| Project | Path | Tests | Test Command |
|---------|------|-------|-------------|
| **Orchestra** v7.1.0 | `Orchestra/` | ~1,551 | `python -m pytest` |
| **Synapse** v5.2.1 | `Synapse/` + `~/.synapse/` | ~973 | `python -m pytest tests/ -v` |
| **OTTO OS** v5.0.0-dev | `OTTO_OS/otto_v4/` | 93+4 | `cd otto_v4 && python -m pytest tests/ -v -m "not integration"` |
| **OTTO Agents** v0.1.0 | `OTTO_OS/OTTO_Agents/` | — | `python -m pytest tests/ -v` |
| **comfyui-agent** v0.2.0 | `comfyui-agent/` | 134+ | `python -m pytest tests/ -v` |
| **RadiantSuite** | `RadiantSuite/` | 7 | `python -m pytest tests/ -v` |
| **Optimizer V8** | `Optimizer_V7_G3/` | — | `python -m pytest tests/ -v` |
| **RTXRemixCommandCenter** | `RTXRemixCommandCenter/` | — | `python -m pytest tests/ -v` |
| **vex-corpus** v0.1.0 | `vex-corpus/` | — | `python -m pytest tests/ -v` |
| **usd-security** v0.1.0 | `usd-security/` | — | `python -m pytest tests/ -v` |
| **Substrate Tools** | `~/.claude/substrate/tools/` | 293 | `python -m pytest tests/ -v` |

### Shipped / Parked

| Project | Path | Notes |
|---------|------|-------|
| **houdini-connector** | `houdini-connector/` | Shipped, C++/Python HDK plugin |
| **usd-cognitive-substrate** | `usd-cognitive-substrate/` | Merged into Orchestra |
| **cognitive-orchestrator** | `cognitive-orchestrator/` | Merged into Orchestra |
| **persistent-state-hypothesis** | `persistent-state-hypothesis/` | Published paper (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18332346) |

### Utilities (not full projects)

- `dylan-fit-sync/` — Push running workouts to NordicTrack X24 via iFit
- `career-check/` — Single-script career utility
- `browser-test/` — Node.js browser testing (JavaScript)
- `claude-code-mobile/` — Mobile workspace for GitHub @claude mentions
- `comfyui-deterministic-toolkit/` — JetBlock deterministic ComfyUI workflows
- `Context-Engineering/` — Context engineering reference library (templates, schemas, curriculum)

### Top-Level Scripts

Dozens of one-off VFX Python scripts (`check_*.py`, `fix_*.py`, `setup_*.py`, `configure_*.py`) for Houdini/USD tasks. These are standalone — no shared module.

## Cross-Project Patterns

### He2025 Determinism

All major projects follow ThinkingMachines [He2025] patterns for defeating nondeterminism:
- `sort_keys=True` in all JSON serialization
- Sorted dict iterations before aggregation
- Stable tiebreakers (no `uuid.uuid4()` in hot paths, use deterministic IDs)
- `time.time()` not used in seeds or hashing
- Orchestra: `COGNITIVE_TILE_SIZE=32` + Kahan summation (batch invariance)

### Testing

- All Python projects use **pytest** (no unittest)
- Orchestra uses `pytest.ini` (not pyproject.toml for pytest config); has `asyncio_mode=auto`
- `--timeout` flag unavailable (pytest-timeout not installed)
- Python 3.14 gotcha: `asyncio.get_event_loop()` raises RuntimeError — use `@pytest.mark.asyncio`
- Orchestra CI excludes: `test_integration.py`, `test_performance.py`, `test_chaos.py`

### Installation Pattern

All major projects: `pip install -e ".[dev]"` for development. Optional features via extras (e.g., `".[dev,websocket,mcp]"`).

### Windows Gotchas

- **Encoding**: Use ASCII arrows (`<-`) not Unicode — cp1252 breaks in many contexts
- **Imports for mocking**: `httpx`, `websockets` must be module-level for `mock.patch` to work
- **Platform**: Windows, AMD Threadripper PRO 7965WX (24C/48T), RTX 4090 (24GB), 128GB DDR5

## Shared Infrastructure

### `~/.claude/` — Global Config

- `CLAUDE.md` — Cognitive substrate: reasoning protocols, workflow scaffolds, code patterns (always auto-loaded)
- `commands/` — 16 slash-command agents from [Context-Engineering](https://github.com/davidkimai/Context-Engineering) (`/research`, `/test`, `/security`, `/optimize`, `/deploy`, `/monitor`, `/cli`, `/doc`, `/data`, `/meta`, `/alignment`, `/diligence`, `/legal`, `/lit`, `/marketing`, `/comms`)
- `substrate/tools/` — Substrate tool suite (293 tests, 86% coverage)
- `substrate/knowledge/` — Knowledge prims (89 prims, 340+ triggers)
- `projects/_index.md` — Project orchestration (FOCUS/HOLDING/PARKED status)
- `session_state.json` — Cross-session state tracking

### `~/.synapse/` — Synapse Companion

- `agent/` — Autonomous Agent SDK (`anthropic` 0.75.0, `ws://localhost:9999/synapse`)
- `design/` — Complete design system (tokens, 21 SVGs, Qt styles)
- `houdini/` — Shelf and panel integration for Houdini
- `install.py` — Installer with `--dry-run`, `--verify`, `--uninstall`

### `~/.orchestra/` — Orchestra Runtime State

- `bcm/` — BCM learning trails (2-hour decay half-life)
- `state/` — Session state

## Lighting Law (VFX — Never Violate)

When working with any PBR renderer (Karma, Arnold, RenderMan, V-Ray):
- **Intensity is ALWAYS 1.0 or below** — never set intensity > 1
- **Brightness controlled by EXPOSURE** (logarithmic, in stops)
- Key:fill ratio 3:1 = 1.585 stops difference; 4:1 = 2.0 stops
- USD exposure parm: `xn__inputsexposure_vya`, control: `xn__inputsexposure_control_wcb` = `"set"`

## Key External Paths

- **ComfyUI**: `G:\COMFYUI_Database` (note: `Custom_Nodes` with capital C, N)
- **Houdini Projects**: `D:\HOUDINI_PROJECTS_2025\`
- **Vercel Portfolio**: `G:\VERCEL_BACKUP\my-vercel-website\` (Next.js/React)
- **AI Framework R&D**: `H:\My Drive\AI_Framework_RnD_2025\Frameworks` (parked)
